title: VLUN: a provenance-preserving smart-contract security reasoning dataset
description: A provenance-preserving corpus of smart-contract security findings across Solidity, Rust, Move, Cairo, Circom, Noir, Leo, TypeScript, Go, Vyper and Clarity. Every record traces to a public artefact and every claim carries its evidence type. Governing rule: truth over scale; unknown is a counted outcome. Data layers are CC BY 4.0; pipeline scripts are MIT; third-party source is not licensed here at all (see NOTICE.md).
notes: DOI is minted by Zenodo on first publish (see docs/ARCHIVAL.md). After publishing, copy the DOI back into CITATION.cff (doi: + preferred-citation.doi) and regenerate the README so the citable artifact is pinned in-repo.
